info.name: EODHD Financial Data Calendar Fundamentals API
Retrieve bulk fundamental data for an exchange

params.name: EXCHANGE
params.description: Exchange code (e.g., 'US', 'LSE', 'TO').

params.name: api_token
params.description: Your API token for authentication.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Comma-separated list of symbols to filter (e.g., 'AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL').

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for pagination (number of records to skip).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 500).

params.name: version
params.description: API version for response format.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Output format.

items.docs: Fetches fundamental data in bulk for all symbols on a given exchange. Supports filtering by specific symbols and data sections (General, Highlights, Valuation, etc.).

info.name: Retrieve filtered fundamental data for a specific symbol

params.name: ticker
params.description: The ticker symbol in the format SYMBOL.EXCHANGE, e.g., 'AAPL.US' for Apple Inc. on NASDAQ.

params.name: api_token
params.description: Your API token for authentication. Use 'demo' for limited access with specific symbols.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter parameter to specify data section and optional sub-sections, e.g., `Financials::Balance_Sheet::quarterly::2024-06-30`. Supported sections include General, Highlights, Valuation, SharesStats, Technicals, SplitsDividends, AnalystRatings, Holders, InsiderTransactions, ESGScores, outstandingShares, Earnings, and Financials. When omitted, returns all sections.

params.name: historical
params.description: Set to 1 to return historical data for certain sections (e.g., outstandingShares).

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for historical data in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for historical data in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: version
params.description: API version for response format.

params.name: no_cache
params.description: Set to 1 to bypass cache and get fresh data.

items.docs: Fetches various sections of fundamental data for a given stock symbol. Use filters to specify the data section and sub-sections, such as Financials::Balance_Sheet::quarterly::2024-06-30 for quarterly Balance Sheet data.

items.docs: Fetches various sections of fundamental data for a given stock symbol using API v1.1. This version differs from v1 in the Earnings Trend section, which is split into Quarterly and Annual sub-objects with an additional "quarter" field on quarterly items. Use filters to specify the data section and sub-sections, such as Financials::Balance_Sheet::quarterly::2024-06-30 for quarterly Balance Sheet data.
